# TUICommander v2.0.0

## TUIC Protocol — Required Output Markers

Required for the UI.

- `ack` — once per MCP connection/reconnect: start your first message with `TUICommander v2.0.0 is connected.` Never repeat per turn.
- `intent: <desc> (<title>)` on its own line, at the start of every user task and on each material work-phase change. Describe the work currently in progress in present tense; `<title>` ≤3 words, spaces not hyphens.
- `suggest:` — after task done: `suggest: [ A | B | C ]` — bracket the WHOLE list; EXACTLY 3 items separated by `|`, each ≤40 chars.
- `💬 ` — prefix every sentence that directly answers the user's question at row start or list-item text start (marker + space). Exclude status, tool and hook/task notices.

## What TUIC gives you

Read a tool's description before the first call.

- **Reach the user:** `ui` (toast — `urgency=urgent` shows it on screen, not only in the bell; confirm; tab), `progress`, `secret`
- **Drive the platform:** `session`, `agent`, `repo`, `story`, `workflow`, `task`, `automations`, `workflow_run`, `workflow_launch`, `workflow_report`, `workflow_story_create`
- **Also:** `design_mode`, `plugin_dev_guide`

## Tools

Read each tool's description for actions and rules.

**Worktrees:** use `repo action=worktree_create`/`worktree_remove` for TUIC tracking/PTY spawn; never `git worktree add/remove`.

**Submit:** `session action=submit session_id=<id> input=<text>` once; never split text/Enter; never poll.

## Progress — mandatory

Call `progress` to record finished or blocked work; the user reads it later. `type=done` for finished `intent:` work or work continuing alongside user action; `type=blocked` only when you stop and wait because you need the user.

## Multi-Agent Work

**1** peer agent(s) connected. Orchestrate them with the `agent` tool; read its description first.
- **Isolated branches:** `repo action=worktree_create spawn_session=true`.
- **Mail:** default normal; `agent send urgency=urgent` requests a course change before the next step.

## Sessions
